AI-optimized networking that unifies scale, speed, and resilience—so AI workloads run faster, more
efficiently, and at global scale.

[See what's new][31]

Purpose-built programmable silicon powers networks with leading performance, efficiency, and scale –
optimized for AI workloads across hyperscalers, service providers, enterprises, and data centers.

[Explore Silicon One][32]

and unified management across data center, cloud, campus, and IoT environments.

[Explore Hybrid Mesh Firewall][33]
[Close-up of networking equipment with multiple ports and visible Cisco logo]

Security is embedded at every layer of the network, scaling to support any AI application while
simplifying even the most sophisticated campus and enterprise environment.

[Learn about Smart Switches][34]
[Close-up of networking equipment featuring Ethernet ports, status LEDs, and network icons]

### The AI-ready platform the edge demands

Redefine edge computing with a full-stack platform that delivers data center performance,
modularity, centralized management, and built-in security where you need it most.

[See the future of the edge][35]

Assistant messages]

troubleshooting, learning, automation, and agent-driven guidance to power Cisco support and
professional services.

[Learn about Cisco IQ][36]

True progress in AI comes from harnessing data with intelligence and purpose. NetApp helps
organizations unleash genius in their data, teams, and business. Because in a world of chaos, only
the prepared rise above.

### When stakes are highest, NetApp delivers

NetApp technology is the backbone of modern football, and Super Bowl LX showed what’s possible when
organizations treat their data as a strategic asset.

rapidly, forcing innovation across the compute, interconnect and switching domains of accelerated

Marvell Enterprise Solutions
[Marvell Enterprise Solutions]
ENTERPRISE

### Modernizing and Securing Networks

To power digital transformation, there must be a more robust, secure and autonomous enterprise
network that spans from HQ to branch to data center to cloud. Network equipment must support rising
bandwidth demands, a more complex threat landscape and the analytics needed to power AIOps tools.
Marvell has a networking and compute portfolio that delivers performance, intelligence, security and
telemetry needed for the modern enterprise network.

[Learn More][122]
Marvell 5G wireless carrier solutions
[Marvell 5G wireless carrier solutions]
CARRIER

### Connecting the World with 5G Network Silicon

With increased capabilities, performance and edge intelligence, 5G enables a plethora of new
consumer and enterprise applications that promise to transform entire industries and serve the
world’s diverse connectivity needs for years to come. Marvell compute, security and networking
platforms effectively operate on a global scale with the performance and programmability that enable
carriers to sustainably innovate in this frontier without compromise.

To realize the promise of AI, hyperscalers are undertaking one of the largest infrastructure
buildouts in history—and they rely on Marvell as a critical AI infrastructure partner. Marvell
designs custom silicon tailored for any application and offers the industry’s most comprehensive
portfolio of interconnects and network switch products. From custom compute to rack, row, data

### Scaling AI

As the number and size of AI models explodes, data center infrastructure requirements are evolving
rapidly, forcing innovation across the compute, interconnect and switching domains of accelerated
infrastructure. Marvell custom silicon and system-level connectivity platforms enable hyperscalers
to design and implement their own unique AI data-center architectures optimized for their own unique
applications.

[Learn More][121]
Marvell Enterprise Solutions
[Marvell Enterprise Solutions]
ENTERPRISE

### Modernizing and Securing Networks

To power digital transformation, there must be a more robust, secure and autonomous enterprise
network that spans from HQ to branch to data center to cloud. Network equipment must support rising
bandwidth demands, a more complex threat landscape and the analytics needed to power AIOps tools.
Marvell has a networking and compute portfolio that delivers performance, intelligence, security and
telemetry needed for the modern enterprise network.

[Learn More][122]
Marvell 5G wireless carrier solutions
[Marvell 5G wireless carrier solutions]
CARRIER

### Connecting the World with 5G Network Silicon

With increased capabilities, performance and edge intelligence, 5G enables a plethora of new
consumer and enterprise applications that promise to transform entire industries and serve the
world’s diverse connectivity needs for years to come. Marvell compute, security and networking
platforms effectively operate on a global scale with the performance and programmability that enable
carriers to sustainably innovate in this frontier without compromise.

## [Системы хранения данных HPE в 2025][12]

При подготовке к экзамену HPE по системам хранения данных HPE0-J68 обратил внимание, что у данного
вендора появилось много новых моделей и наименований линеек, с которыми я ранее не сталкивался.
Плотно работать с системами хранения данных HPE в последние несколько лет мне не приходилось и стало
очень любопытно, что кардинально поменялось в данном направлении у HPE. На первый взгляд бросается в
глаза обилие систем хранения данных под брендом **Alletra**. Что примечательно, компания HPE не
покупала производителя СХД с таким именем. Также привлекает внимание живучесть линейки начального
уровня **HPE** **MSA**, которая сейчас предлагается уже в седьмом поколении. В рамках данной статьи
постарался вникнуть в эволюцию СХД у HPE за последние несколько лет и изложить свои субъективные
выводы и соображения дальше по тексту.

[Читать далее «Системы хранения данных HPE в 2025»][13]
Автор [Andrey Useinov][14]Опубликовано [07/07/202515/07/2025][15]Рубрики [Infrastructure][16]Метки
[HPE][17], [infrastructure][18], [Storage][19][Добавить комментарий к записи Системы хранения данных
HPE в 2025][20]

## [СУБД Oracle и OC Oracle Linux 8][21]

Казалось бы на первый взгляд, банальная задача по установке базы данных **Oracle 19с **в
операционной системе **Oracle Linux 8** от одного и того же производителя ПО является тривиальным
делом. Однако, к своему удивлению столкнулся с тем, что в этом есть определенные принципиальные
сложности, которые не освещены в документации. Как оказалось, в ОС Oracle Linux 8 идет **kernel
5.15.x**. А данное ядро перестало поддерживать функционал **ASMFD**, который стандартно используется
в базе данных Oracle для доступа к дисковой подсистеме. Подсистема **ASM — Automatic Storage
Management **давно стала неотъемлимой составляющей СУБД Oracle, без которой просто невозможно теперь
использовать саму базу данных. **Oracle ASMFD** или **ASM Filter Driver** — это самый современный
способ, который использует база данных Oracle для доступа к дискам. И вот, как выяснилось,
операционная система Oracle Linux 8, которая выпускается корпорацией Oracle не поддерживает из
коробки ключевой продукт в виде СУБД Oracle от этой же компании.

[Читать далее «СУБД Oracle и OC Oracle Linux 8»][22]
Автор [Andrey Useinov][23]Опубликовано [29/05/202502/06/2025][24]Рубрики [Oracle][25]Метки
[infrastructure][26], [Linux][27], [Oracle][28][Добавить комментарий к записи СУБД Oracle и OC
Oracle Linux 8][29]

## [Модели устройств Pure Storage FlashArray][30]

Часто возникающий вопрос при выборе систем хранения данных от [Pure Storage][31] — какую конкретно
модель выбрать и в чем между ними существенная разница. На текущий момент марта 2025 года есть 2
основных типа систем хранения данных у Pure Storage — **FlashArray** и **FlashBlade**. Сейчас нам
будет интересен именно первый тип, а именно **FlashArray**, который предоставляет функционал
корпоративных СХД с доступом как через протоколы SAN (FC, iSCSI, NVMe-over-FC), так и протоколы NAS
(NFS, SMB). FlashArray имеет 4 разных линейки, с различными моделями внутри каждой линейки. При
этом, грубо говоря, технический функционал предоставляемый всеми конкретными моделями является
идентичным. Для конечного пользователя данных систем основные технические отличия представляют собой
— доступный объем емкости хранения данных, а также величина задержек при обращении к СХД.

[Читать далее «Модели устройств Pure Storage FlashArray»][32]
Автор [Andrey Useinov][33]Опубликовано [24/03/202505/05/2025][34]Рубрики [Infrastructure][35]Метки
[infrastructure][36], [PureStorage][37], [Storage][38][Добавить комментарий к записи Модели
устройств Pure Storage FlashArray][39]

## [Специфика использования Retention Lock на Data Domain][40]

Один из основных трендов в корпоративном IT секторе в Узбекистане за последнее время — борьба с
**RANSOMWARE** различными возможными способами. Судя по всему, похожая тенденция наблюдается во
многих странах. Обусловлено это реальными громкими случаями с работой шифровальщиков, которые
периодически происходят по всему миру. Зачастую это приводит к остановке в работе целых заводов,
предприятий и производств. И Узбекистан тут не исключение, такое случается и у нас. Многие компании
стараются делать регулярно резервные копии своих данных и информационных систем. Однако, и это может
оказаться не панацеей, так как и бекапы могут быть зашифрованы или удалены злоумышленниками.
Специализированный аплаинс дедупликации от Dell — **PowerProtect DD** или **Data Domain** предлагает
интересный функционал под названием **Retention Lock**, который позволяет защитить записанные файлы
резервных копий от изменения или удаления. Данная опция существует у Data Domain уже давно и хорошо
интегрируется с программным обеспечением резервн

## [СУБД Oracle и OC Oracle Linux 8][21]

Казалось бы на первый взгляд, банальная задача по установке базы данных **Oracle 19с **в
операционной системе **Oracle Linux 8** от одного и того же производителя ПО является тривиальным
делом. Однако, к своему удивлению столкнулся с тем, что в этом есть определенные принципиальные
сложности, которые не освещены в документации. Как оказалось, в ОС Oracle Linux 8 идет **kernel
5.15.x**. А данное ядро перестало поддерживать функционал **ASMFD**, который стандартно используется
в базе данных Oracle для доступа к дисковой подсистеме. Подсистема **ASM — Automatic Storage
Management **давно стала неотъемлимой составляющей СУБД Oracle, без которой просто невозможно теперь
использовать саму базу данных. **Oracle ASMFD** или **ASM Filter Driver** — это самый современный
способ, который использует база данных Oracle для доступа к дискам. И вот, как выяснилось,
операционная система Oracle Linux 8, которая выпускается корпорацией Oracle не поддерживает из
коробки ключевой продукт в виде СУБД Oracle от этой же компании.

## [Обучение и сертификация Nutanix][51]

Хотелось бы поделиться своим опытом прохождения обучающих курсов и сертификации у компании
[Nutanix][52]. Это один из ведущих создателей программного обеспечения для виртуализации и
гиперконвергенции, который старается конкурировать с всемирно признанным монстром коммерческой
виртуализации VMware. После поглощения Broadcom-ом компании VMware интерес к Nutanix во всем мире
возрос только еще больше. Для знакомства с продуктами Nutanix можно использовать ресурсы портала
[university.nutanix.com][53], а также возможности [test drive на портале Nutanix][54]. Надо
добавить, что для сотрудников организаций, которые являются партнерами Nutanix, предоставляется
бесплатный доступ к обучающим курсам, а также периодически появляется возможность получить ваучеры
на полную стоимость сдачи сертификационных экзаменов Nutanix. К слову сказать в области коммерческих
IT продуктов такой щедростью в части обучения своим технологиям мало кто может похвастаться.

## [My Favourite Youtube channels in English language][64]

Nowdays many things can be learnt from [YouTube.com][65] web site absolutely free. This internet
service has become a virtual university for million people. From my point of view it is a very
helpful tool for improving **English Listening** skills, that can be used by anyone. To listen and
to understand a foreign language speech is crucial and essential for any language learner. Morover
there are a lot of different accents in English language in the United Kingdom itself and other
English speaking countries. In addition some sounds in English are very strange for me as a Russian
native speaker. And I suppose that many learners of English language from non-English speaking
countries have the similar problem. Buy everybody can easily overcome these challenges everywhere
and improve his/her Listening capabilities with the help of YouTube. I have been using it recent
years for educational purposes. I would like to share my personal list of different youtube
channels, that are interesting for me. I have not included here youtube channels, that specialize in
teaching different aspects of English language itself. Common criterias for all of these channels
are using English language as a main communication tool and using this language at the level of
native speaker.

## [Living in an English speaking country vs using italki.com][75]

Everyone thinks about immersing in the English culture and language during a process of learning
this foreign language. I guess there is little or no exception. This is specially important for
people who would like to achive high level of fluency in English language. **Proficiency in
Speaking** is one aspect that requires live interactions with native speakers. You can improve
**Listening, Reading and Writing** of English in any spot on the Earth without direct face-to-face
contacts with the help of modern technologies. For example, you can [work on your Listening skills
with the help of YouTube][76]. Different Internet forums and online communitites give you a lot of
opportunity to practice in writing on every day basis. As for me I like to share my opinion in
English about interesting places worldwide on [www.tripadvisor.com][77]. Maybe even Speaking
abilities can be now significantly improved with the help of the modern Internet technologies?

## [Опыт сертификации с Pure Storage][86]

Мое знакомство с компанией **[Pure Storage][87]**, а также с продуктами этой фирмы произошло в
текущем 2024 году. Откровенно говоря, для меня это было своеобразным открытием. Хотя данный вендор в
области систем хранения данных работает с 2009 года, мне с ним сталкиваться не приходилось. Общее
впечатление от знакомства с продуктами, услугами и людьми из данной компании — **инновационный
подход в самом настоящем его виде**. Обилие нестандартных решений, а также смелый взгляд на старые
проблемы — вызывает с моей стороны только восхищение. У Pure Storage как и других вендоров в данной
индустрии есть своя образовательная и сертификационная система, которая позволяет обеспечивать
необходимый уровень знаний у специалистов, занимающихся продуктами и услугами данного производителя.
Хотелось бы поделиться своим первым опытом взаимодействия с этой образовательной платформой.

**PowerProtect DD** часто возникает потребность в проверке пропускной способности между клиентами
резервного копирования и стораджем дедупликации. Представьте себе ситуацию, что со стороны Data
Domain у Вас подключены два 25G порта в LACP транке, аналогичные интерфейсы используются на стороне

# A decentralized, efficient, and robust foundation for humanity's information

Filecoin is the world's largest decentralized storage network, built to keep data secure,
verifiable, and free from centralized control.

[Store data][6][Start building][7]
[Earth from deep space, showing the planet and the stars.]

## Join industry leaders storing with Filecoin

## Filecoin by the numbers
* ### 1.95 EiB
  
  network storage capacity
  
  Enough to store Wikipedia's text 22 million times over
* ### 482
  
  large clients
  
  With more than 1TiB active data
* ### +5,000
  
  smart contracts
  
  Deployed via the Filecoin Virtual Machine (FVM)

## Filecoin is reshaping how the world stores data

### A better foundation for the next generation of the web.

Today, a small handful of corporations control most of the world's data, creating centralized
gatekeepers that introduce single points of failure.

Filecoin offers a fundamentally different approach to data storage: distributing data across a
decentralized, global network secured by cryptographic proofs, ensuring greater security and
resilience.

From cultural archives to scientific research, petabytes of data are already stored on Filecoin. The
decentralized model empowers users with true autonomy over their information, building a foundation
for a more open, resilient, and user-controlled web.

[Store data][8][Become a storage provider][9]
[Interior of a grand historic library with high vaulted wooden ceiling, rows of tall bookshelves,
and marble busts lining the hall.]

## How Filecoin storage stacks up

How decentralized storage compares to traditional cloud storage

Filecoin
* Resilience through global redundancy
* Censorship resistance by design
* Open, permissionless participation
* Verifiable storage commitments
* Economic incentives for participants
* Data outlives institutions
Traditional Cloud
* Single points of failure
* Susceptible to censorship and takedowns
* Controlled by corporate gatekeepers
* Opaque trust models
* Profits flow to shareholders
* Data loss if provider fails
[Store data][10][Learn more about Filecoin][11]

## The incentive layer for IPFS

Filecoin adds incentivized, persistent storage to the InterPlanetary File System (IPFS), a
peer-to-peer network for content-addressable data, creating a powerful, versatile, and long-term
home for data.

Filecoin makes it easy for IPFS users to reliably store their data directly on the Filecoin network.
The result is a decentralized, storage layer opening up an entirely new class of applications and
use cases.

[Learn more about IPFS][12]
[Illustration showing the IPFS cube logo in the center with Filecoin logos surrounding it.]

## Open, scalable, and built for the future

### A decentralized, verifiable storage layer that scales effortlessly.

Power chain storage, dApps, data-heavy SaaS platforms, immutable archives, and beyond. Accelerate
development with open source tools, native IPFS integration, cross-chain data bridges, and FEVM for
programmable smart contracts. Build without compromise, knowing you control your data, not
centralized gatekeepers.

[Start building][13][Documentation][14]
[A rocket launching into the sky with bright flames and smoke clouds rising from the launch pad,
reflected in the water below.]

Insights, updates, ecosystem spotlights, and community stories, directly from the teams building
Filecoin.

  Jun 7, 2026| ProPGF Team

# A decentralized, efficient, and robust foundation for humanity's information

Filecoin is the world's largest decentralized storage network, built to keep data secure,
verifiable, and free from centralized control.

[Store data][6][Start building][7]
[Earth from deep space, showing the planet and the stars.]

## Join industry leaders storing with Filecoin

## Filecoin by the numbers
* ### 1.95 EiB
  
  network storage capacity
  
  Enough to store Wikipedia's text 22 million times over
* ### 482
  
  large clients
  
  With more than 1TiB active data
* ### +5,000
  
  smart contracts
  
  Deployed via the Filecoin Virtual Machine (FVM)

## Filecoin is reshaping how the world stores data

### A better foundation for the next generation of the web.

Today, a small handful of corporations control most of the world's data, creating centralized
gatekeepers that introduce single points of failure.

Filecoin offers a fundamentally different approach to data storage: distributing data across a
decentralized, global network secured by cryptographic proofs, ensuring greater security and
resilience.

From cultural archives to scientific research, petabytes of data are already stored on Filecoin. The
decentralized model empowers users with true autonomy over their information, building a foundation
for a more open, resilient, and user-controlled web.

[Store data][8][Become a storage provider][9]
[Interior of a grand historic library with high vaulted wooden ceiling, rows of tall bookshelves,
and marble busts lining the hall.]

## How Filecoin storage stacks up

How decentralized storage compares to traditional cloud storage

Filecoin
* Resilience through global redundancy
* Censorship resistance by design
* Open, permissionless participation
* Verifiable storage commitments
* Economic incentives for participants
* Data outlives institutions
Traditional Cloud
* Single points of failure
* Susceptible to censorship and takedowns
* Controlled by corporate gatekeepers
* Opaque trust models
* Profits flow to shareholders
* Data loss if provider fails
[Store data][10][Learn more about Filecoin][11]

## The incentive layer for IPFS

Filecoin adds incentivized, persistent storage to the InterPlanetary File System (IPFS), a
peer-to-peer network for content-addressable data, creating a powerful, versatile, and long-term
home for data.

Filecoin makes it easy for IPFS users to reliably store their data directly on the Filecoin network.
The result is a decentralized, storage layer opening up an entirely new class of applications and
use cases.

[Learn more about IPFS][12]
[Illustration showing the IPFS cube logo in the center with Filecoin logos surrounding it.]

## Open, scalable, and built for the future

### A decentralized, verifiable storage layer that scales effortlessly.

Power chain storage, dApps, data-heavy SaaS platforms, immutable archives, and beyond. Accelerate
development with open source tools, native IPFS integration, cross-chain data bridges, and FEVM for
programmable smart contracts. Build without compromise, knowing you control your data, not
centralized gatekeepers.

[Start building][13][Documentation][14]
[A rocket launching into the sky with bright flames and smoke clouds rising from the launch pad,
reflected in the water below.]

## Kiddle News 

[[Spain national football team's logo.]][21]
Spain national football team's logo.
* **[Andy Burnham][22]** becomes the [Prime Minister of the United Kingdom][23].
* **[Spain][24] defeats** [Argentina][25] **1–0 to claim the** [World Cup][26].
* **[Luis de la Fuente][27]**, the manager of Spain's national team, has made history by becoming
  the oldest individual to win a World Cup as a manager, achieving this milestone at the age of 65.
* The **[Long March 10B][28]** marked the first successful net-based [rocket recovery][29] ever
  achieved.
* The **[Great Pacific Garbage Patch][30]** is believed to have increased "10-fold each decade"
  since 1945. Some of the plastic in the patch is over 50 years old.
* **[Artemis IV][31]** is going to be the first mission to land humans on the Moon since the [Apollo
  17][32] mission in 1972. The mission is currently planned for an early 2028 launch.

# The World's Most Distributed Cloud Computing Platform

## Build and deliver low-latency, edge native applications on Akamai Cloud

[ Sign up with Google ][114]
[ Github ][115]
[ Email ][116]

By providing your email address or using a single sign-on provider to create an account, you agree
to our [Terms of Service][117] and have reviewed our [Privacy Policy][118] and [Cookie Policy][119].

## The State of Enterprise AI: Gaining Experience and Managing Risks

A Forrester consulting study, commissioned by Akamai, explores how enterprises are boosting CX and
managing AI risks in 2025.

[ Read study ][120]
[The State of Enterprise AI: Gaining Experience and Managing Risks]

## What's new

#### Akamai + Fermyon Wasm function-as-a-service

Innovate and execute lightweight code at the edge                                                   
          

[ Learn more ][121]

### Optimizing AI inference: Build a foundation for scalability and efficiency

Discover cost-saving strategies for AI inference, including edge deployment, model optimization, and
FinOps best practices to scale efficiently.

[ Download white paper ][122]

### Distributed Cloud: Taking AI to the Edge research study

A 2024 Forrester Consulting study, commissioned by Akamai, explores distributed cloud interest among
cloud strategy decision-makers.

[ Read study ][123]

### AI inference efficiency: Spend less and do more

As demonstrated using the Stable Diffusion model on Akamai Cloud, AI inference costs can be reduced
by up to 86%. Discover strategies to optimize performance and lower expenses.

[ Download white paper ][124]

## Learn how we cut our public cloud spend by 40% in one year

Read the Project Cirrus brief for insights on business objectives, cloud risk management, and our
five-step migration process.

[ Read brief ][125]

## The cloud of the future, today

Essential strategies for optimizing your cloud infrastructure and enhancing application performance.

### Lower your cloud bills

Budgeting for cloud infrastructure should be easy. Enjoy flat, predictable pricing with low egress
fees and a free egress allowance.

[ Explore costs ][126]

### Deploy low-latency apps

Enhance the performance of your VMs, containers, storage, and databases with support from our
Qualified Compute Partners or our popular marketplace apps.

[ Explore low-latency ][127]

### Scale across the globe

Control where data is managed and scale to meet demand in key global customer markets.

[ Explore scalability ][128]

### Get real cloud portability

Choose the right technologies to power different workloads. Eliminate the need to use proprietary
services.

[ Explore portability ][129]

## Get up to US$5,000 in cloud credits*

See how Akamai’s public cloud can help your business run better. Reduce costs, increase reliability,
and drive results. Offer available to new and existing enterprise customers.

[ Apply now ][130]

*See [Promotion Redemption Rules and Conditions][131]

## Explore our products

Build and deploy on the world’s most distributed platform.

[ See all products ][132]

### CPU

Match Shared CPU, Dedicated CPU, or High Memory compute plans to your applications’ needs and
budget.

[ View product details ][133]

### App Platform

Deploy powerful cloud native applications on Kubernetes in minutes with automated infrastructure.

[ View product details ][134]

### GPU

Parallel process workloads including machine learning, scientific computing, and video processing.

[ View product details ][135]

### Linode Kubernetes Engine

Managed K8s container orchestration engine for containerized workloads.

[ View product details ][136]

### Managed Databases

Fully managed database service for MySQL and PostgreSQL. Deploy a managed database cluster in
production.

[ View product details ][137]

### Object Storage

Store your data for high availability, durability, or distribution.

[ View product details ][138]

## Cloud Computing Foundations Certification

Develop a foundational understanding of cloud computing and explore Akamai’s cloud computing
ecosystem.

[ View details ][139]
[ Start learning ][140]

## Learn more

### Pricing

CPU, transfer, storage, and RAM bundled into one flat price.

[ See pricing ][141]

### Support experience

Get expert advice and assistance whenever you need it from our award-winning support team of highly
trained service professionals.

[ Explore support ][142]

### Developer portal

Comprehensive guides, documentation, and endpoints.

[ Explore hub ][143]

## Ready to get started or have questions?

Set up your free account today or contact a sales consultant to learn more.

[ Create account ][144]
[ Contact us ][145]

### See if you qualify for up to US$5,000 in cloud credits

We’re here to help you with large deployments, migrations, app optimization, architecture
assessments, security and reliability audits, and much more. For support or account issues, please
visit our [support page][146].

FAQ

## Frequently asked questions
* What does Lucidity do?
  
  Lucidity is the autonomous cloud storage intelligence platform that monitors, decides, and acts to
  eliminate block storage waste across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud — without requiring downtime or
  architectural modifications.
* Which clouds does Lucidity support?
  
  Lucidity supports AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud — including AWS EBS, Azure Managed Disks,
  and GCP Persistent Disks.
* How much can Lucidity save me on cloud storage?
  
  Lucidity customers reduce block storage costs by 50–70% on average, improving utilization from
  roughly 30% to 70–80%+.
* How long does the free Assessment take?
  
  The Assessment takes about 15 minutes — our record is 7 minutes.
* Is my data safe? Does Lucidity have access to my data?
  
  No. Lucidity never reads, copies, or moves your application data. It only collects
  infrastructure-level metadata through your cloud provider's APIs.
* Does Lucidity require an agent or downtime?
  
  Zero downtime — Lucidity is the only solution that can shrink a live partition without disrupting
  running workloads. The Assessment and Lumen are fully agentless; AutoScaler uses a lightweight
  agent (≤2% CPU, ~200MB RAM).
* What's the difference between AutoScaler, Lumen, and Assessment?
  
  Assessment is the free 15-minute starting point that shows your waste. Lumen provides agentless
  visibility and recommendations for idle disks and tier mismatches. AutoScaler continuously
  right-sizes live block storage autonomously with zero downtime.
* How is Lucidity different from Zesty, Spot Storage, or Azure Advisor?
  
  Lucidity is the only platform that shrinks live block storage without downtime and runs across
  AWS, Azure, and GCP with application-aware intelligence — not just single-cloud recommendations.
* What is autonomous storage management?
  
  Autonomous storage management is the use of intelligent software to monitor, decide, and act on
  cloud block storage in real time — without scripts, manual tickets, or downtime.
* How much cloud storage do enterprises typically waste?
  
  The average enterprise uses only 15–30% of provisioned cloud block storage, leaving 70–85% paid
  for but unused.
* Does Lucidity work with Windows workloads on Azure?
  
  Yes. Lucidity has deep Windows Server support and is purpose-built for Azure-heavy enterprises.
* Is Lucidity SOC 2 compliant?
  
  Yes. Lucidity is SOC 2 Type II certified.
* How fast does Lucidity pay for itself?
  
  Most customers see ROI within 60–90 days.

See the waste. Fix it autonomously.

FAQ

## Frequently asked questions
* What does Lucidity do?
  
  Lucidity is the autonomous cloud storage intelligence platform that monitors, decides, and acts to
  eliminate block storage waste across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud — without requiring downtime or
  architectural modifications.
* Which clouds does Lucidity support?
  
  Lucidity supports AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud — including AWS EBS, Azure Managed Disks,
  and GCP Persistent Disks.
* How much can Lucidity save me on cloud storage?
  
  Lucidity customers reduce block storage costs by 50–70% on average, improving utilization from
  roughly 30% to 70–80%+.
* How long does the free Assessment take?
  
  The Assessment takes about 15 minutes — our record is 7 minutes.
* Is my data safe? Does Lucidity have access to my data?
  
  No. Lucidity never reads, copies, or moves your application data. It only collects
  infrastructure-level metadata through your cloud provider's APIs.
* Does Lucidity require an agent or downtime?
  
  Zero downtime — Lucidity is the only solution that can shrink a live partition without disrupting
  running workloads. The Assessment and Lumen are fully agentless; AutoScaler uses a lightweight
  agent (≤2% CPU, ~200MB RAM).
* What's the difference between AutoScaler, Lumen, and Assessment?
  
  Assessment is the free 15-minute starting point that shows your waste. Lumen provides agentless
  visibility and recommendations for idle disks and tier mismatches. AutoScaler continuously
  right-sizes live block storage autonomously with zero downtime.
* How is Lucidity different from Zesty, Spot Storage, or Azure Advisor?
  
  Lucidity is the only platform that shrinks live block storage without downtime and runs across
  AWS, Azure, and GCP with application-aware intelligence — not just single-cloud recommendations.
* What is autonomous storage management?
  
  Autonomous storage management is the use of intelligent software to monitor, decide, and act on
  cloud block storage in real time — without scripts, manual tickets, or downtime.
* How much cloud storage do enterprises typically waste?
  
  The average enterprise uses only 15–30% of provisioned cloud block storage, leaving 70–85% paid
  for but unused.
* Does Lucidity work with Windows workloads on Azure?
  
  Yes. Lucidity has deep Windows Server support and is purpose-built for Azure-heavy enterprises.
* Is Lucidity SOC 2 compliant?
  
  Yes. Lucidity is SOC 2 Type II certified.
* How fast does Lucidity pay for itself?
  
  Most customers see ROI within 60–90 days.

See the waste. Fix it autonomously.

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

Fresh, standardized, auditable information underpinned by our [Legal-Entity Data Principles][40],
this is data you can trust.

[ Plug in our data ][42]

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

* ## Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
  
  Oracle offers the highest-performing cloud services at the lowest cost. That's why so many of the
  world's biggest technology companies use OCI.
  
  **OCI Tech Customers**
  
  AMD, ByteDance, Meta, NVIDIA, OpenAI, Temu, TikTok, Uber, xAI
  
  The demand for cloud infrastructure for AI training and inferencing greatly exceeds supply. In
  response to this shortage, Oracle is building AI cloud capacity as quickly as we can.
  
  [Learn more][22]
  [Oracle Cloud Infrastructure]
  
  ### Building the World's Largest AI Cloud
  
  1.2 billion watt Texas data center | 500,000 NVIDIA GPUs
* [MultiCloud Database]
  
  ### Oracle AI Database in 200+ Data Centers
  
  Multicloud: 22@AWS, 15@Google, 33@Azure and 135@Oracle Cloud
  
  ## Multicloud AI Database
  
  Oracle AI Database in every cloud
  
  Amazon · Google · Microsoft · Oracle
  
  **Most Advanced Database Technology**
  
  Oracle’s Autonomous and AI Database software running on high-performance Exadata hardware is
  available in Amazon, Google, Microsoft, and Oracle Cloud data centers all over the world.
  
  Pick the cloud you want to use.
  
  Get the same low price everywhere.
  
  [Learn more][23]
* ## AI Data Platform
  
  **AI Models in Oracle Cloud**
  
  Google Gemini, Meta Llama, OpenAI ChatGPT, xAI Grok, and more . . .
  
  **AI Data Catalog**
  
  Unifies all your private structured and unstructured data without moving it – by using the AI Data
  Platform's Data Catalog
  
  [Get started with AI Data Catalog][24]
  
  **AI Data Platform Workbench**
  
  An end-to-end Integrated Development Environment for building any type of AI Application – chat,
  multistep agents, transactions, workflows – on all your data
  
  [Get started with AI Data Platform Workbench][25]
  
  [Learn More][26]
  [AI Data Platform with Multimodal AI models, Public Data and Private Data Lakehouse]
  
  ### AI models reason on private data
  
  All private data unified in data catalog
* [Cloud@Customer]
  
  ### All OCI Services in 3 Racks
  
  Installed in your data center from $250,000 per month
  
  ## Cloud@Customer
  
  **All OCI Services and Applications**
  
  Put the entire Oracle Cloud inside your data center. Cloud@Customer includes every Oracle
  infrastructure service and application. Your data and network traffic stay secure and private
  inside your data center and behind your firewall.
  
  **Enable AI on your Private Data**
  
  Now you can do AI inferencing and multistep reasoning on your private data while keeping that data
  private.
  
  [Learn more][27]
* ## Fusion Applications
  
  Fusion is the only application suite that brings AI to every aspect of your business:
  
  **ERP Applications**
  
  [Finance and Accounting][28]
  [Supply Chain and Manufacturing][29]
  
  **HCM Applications**
  
  [Human Resources][30]
  [Payroll][31]
  
  **Customer Experience**
  
  [Marketing][32]
  [Sales][33]
  [Service][34]
  
  [Learn more][35]
  [Fusion Application Suite]
  
  ### DHL Supply Chain runs on Oracle Fusion
  
  Modernizes back-office operations and enables innovation
* [Health Application Suite]
  
  ### Digital Ambulance
  
  Patients are continually monitored in transit by hospital ER doctors
  
  ## Health Application Suite
  
  Oracle Health is the first of our Application Suites to be entirely rebuilt as a set of AI Agents
  connected by workflows. The Oracle Health Suite includes applications for managing the entire
  healthcare ecosystem including providers: ambulatory clinics, acute care
  hospitals; payers: insurance companies, governments;  and public health and regulatory agencies.
  
  **Healthcare Applications**
  
  Ambulatory Care System for Clinics
  Acute Care System for Hospitals
  Clinical and Financial Operations
  Payer Preauthorization System
  
  **Healthcare Technology Foundation**
  
  Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
  AI Data Platform
  Oracle AI Database
  
  [Learn more][36]

  Oracle provides industry specific cloud application suites for more than two dozen industries.

## Infrastructure
* [Cloud][14]

  Customer][17]

## Applications
* [Fusion][18]
* [Health Suite][19]
* [Industries][20]
* [NetSuite][21]
* ## Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
  
  Oracle offers the highest-performing cloud services at the lowest cost. That's why so many of the
  world's biggest technology companies use OCI.
  
  **OCI Tech Customers**
  
  AMD, ByteDance, Meta, NVIDIA, OpenAI, Temu, TikTok, Uber, xAI
  
  The demand for cloud infrastructure for AI training and inferencing greatly exceeds supply. In
  response to this shortage, Oracle is building AI cloud capacity as quickly as we can.
  
  [Learn more][22]
  [Oracle Cloud Infrastructure]
  
  ### Building the World's Largest AI Cloud
  
  1.2 billion watt Texas data center | 500,000 NVIDIA GPUs
* [MultiCloud Database]
  
  ### Oracle AI Database in 200+ Data Centers
  
  Multicloud: 22@AWS, 15@Google, 33@Azure and 135@Oracle Cloud
  
  ## Multicloud AI Database
  
  Oracle AI Database in every cloud
  
  Amazon · Google · Microsoft · Oracle
  
  **Most Advanced Database Technology**
  
  Oracle’s Autonomous and AI Database software running on high-performance Exadata hardware is
  available in Amazon, Google, Microsoft, and Oracle Cloud data centers all over the world.
  
  Pick the cloud you want to use.
  
  Get the same low price everywhere.
  
  [Learn more][23]
* ## AI Data Platform
  
  **AI Models in Oracle Cloud**
  
  Google Gemini, Meta Llama, OpenAI ChatGPT, xAI Grok, and more . . .
  
  **AI Data Catalog**
  
  Unifies all your private structured and unstructured data without moving it – by using the AI Data
  Platform's Data Catalog
  
  [Get started with AI Data Catalog][24]
  
  **AI Data Platform Workbench**
  
  An end-to-end Integrated Development Environment for building any type of AI Application – chat,
  multistep agents, transactions, workflows – on all your data
  
  [Get started with AI Data Platform Workbench][25]
  
  [Learn More][26]
  [AI Data Platform with Multimodal AI models, Public Data and Private Data Lakehouse]
  
  ### AI models reason on private data
  
  All private data unified in data catalog
* [Cloud@Customer]
  
  ### All OCI Services in 3 Racks
  
  Installed in your data center from $250,000 per month
  
  ## Cloud@Customer
  
  **All OCI Services and Applications**
  
  Put the entire Oracle Cloud inside your data center. Cloud@Customer includes every Oracle
  infrastructure service and application. Your data and network traffic stay secure and private
  inside your data center and behind your firewall.
  
  **Enable AI on your Private Data**
  
  Now you can do AI inferencing and multistep reasoning on your private data while keeping that data
  private.
  
  [Learn more][27]
* ## Fusion Applications
  
  Fusion is the only application suite that brings AI to every aspect of your business:
  
  **ERP Applications**
  
  [Finance and Accounting][28]
  [Supply Chain and Manufacturing][29]
  
  **HCM Applications**
  
  [Human Resources][30]
  [Payroll][31]
  
  **Customer Experience**
  
  [Marketing][32]
  [Sales][33]
  [Service][34]
  
  [Learn more][35]
  [Fusion Application Suite]
  
  ### DHL Supply Chain runs on Oracle Fusion
  
  Modernizes back-office operations and enables innovation
* [Health Application Suite]
  
  ### Digital Ambulance
  
  Patients are continually monitored in transit by hospital ER doctors
  
  ## Health Application Suite
  
  Oracle Health is the first of our Application Suites to be entirely rebuilt as a set of AI Agents
  connected by workflows. The Oracle Health Suite includes applications for managing the entire
  healthcare ecosystem including providers: ambulatory clinics, acute care
  hospitals; payers: insurance companies, governments;  and public health and regulatory agencies.
  
  **Healthcare Applications**
  
  Ambulatory Care System for Clinics
  Acute Care System for Hospitals
  Clinical and Financial Operations
  Payer Preauthorization System
  
  **Healthcare Technology Foundation**
  
  Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
  AI Data Platform
  Oracle AI Database
  
  [Learn more][36]
* ## Industry Specific Applications
  
  Oracle provides industry specific cloud application suites for more than two dozen industries.
  These are modern SaaS applications with built-in AI, machine learning, and analytics. These
  industry applications integrate seamlessly with core business functions in Fusion ERP, HCM, Supply
  Chain, Finance, and Customer Experience. Here are a few examples:
  
  **Banking Suite**
  
  Includes core banking, anti-money laundering, risk management, compliance, and AI analytics.
  
  **Construction and Engineering**
  
  Includes project management, procurement, supplier analytics, subcontractor payments, cost
  controls, and more.
  
  **Retail Suite**
  
  Includes merchandising, multistore inventory management, omnichannel demand forecasting, etc.
  
  [Learn More][37]
  
  * [Automotive][38]
  * [Banking][39]
  * [Communications][40]
  * [Construction and Engineering][41]

  * [Consumer Packaged Goods][42]

  * [Wholesale Distribution][60]
* ## First Cloud Company
  
  NetSuite pioneered a new generation of SaaS applications and cloud technology.
  * **43,000+ customers in 200+ countries and dependent territories**
  * **77% of the Forbes Cloud 100 companies are NetSuite customers**
  * **61% of technology IPOs since 2011 are NetSuite customers**
  
  ## NetSuite
  
  **Finance and Accounting**
  General Ledger, AP/AR, tax management,  and more
  
  **Global**
  Consolidation, Multicurrency, Multilanguage
  
  **CRM**
  Sales, Marketing, Customer Service
  
  **Planning and Budgeting**
  
  
  **E-Commerce**
  Full featured online store B2B, B2C
  
  **Human Capital Management**
  HR and Payroll
  
  **Analytics and Reporting**
  Dashboards, KPIs, AI Queries
  
  **Supply Chain and Manufacturing
  Resource Planning**
  
  [Learn More][61]

# A better internet starts with privacy and freedom

Take control of your data with end-to-end encryption.

[Create a free account][143][Compare plans][144]
Trusted by over 100 million users and organizations
Average app rating[4.5 stars]
[CNET, Independent IndyBest and PCMag Editors' Choice]
Recommended by the experts

## Communicate and browse. Privately.

[Proton Mail]
[Proton Calendar]

### Proton Mail and Calendar

Defeat spam, tracking, and ads with encrypted [email][145] and a secure calendar.

[Get it for free][146][Explore Proton Mail
][147]
[Proton VPN]

### Proton VPN

Browse privately and access content from anywhere with a secure, fast [VPN(new window)][148].

[Get Proton VPN][149][Explore Proton VPN
][150]
Mail

#### No trackers. No distractions. Just your email.

VPN

#### Stay protected online, wherever you go.

VPN

#### Ultra-fast gaming, anywhere in the world.

Calendar

#### Organize your schedule privately.

Previous slide
Next slide

## Store, share, collaborate. Securely.

[Proton Drive]

### Proton Drive

Safeguard your files and photos with end-to-end encrypted [cloud storage][151].

[Get it for free][152][Explore Proton Drive
][153]
[Proton Docs]

### Proton Docs

Edit as a team with [collaborative documents][154], safe from prying eyes.

[Get it for free][155][Explore Proton Docs
][156]
[Proton Sheets]

### Proton Sheets

Protect and organize sensitive data in encrypted [online spreadsheets][157].

[Get it for free][158][Explore Proton Sheets
][159]

## Defend your digital life from hackers. Effortlessly.

[Proton Pass]

### Proton Pass

Generate and store strong passwords with a [password manager][160] that automatically syncs across
all your devices and alerts you to breaches.

[Get it for free][161][Explore Proton Pass
][162]
[Proton Authenticator]

### Proton Authenticator

Sync and back up your two-factor authentication (2FA) codes across all devices with a secure
[authenticator app][163].

[Get it for free][164][Explore Proton Authenticator
][165]

## Host and join confidential meetings

[Proton Meet]

### Proton Meet

Collaborate with your team or catch up with family and friends knowing your [video calls][166] are
protected by end-to-end encryption.

[Start a meeting][167][Explore Proton Meet
][168]

## Powerful AI that respects your privacy.

[Lumo AI]

### Lumo by Proton

An [AI assistant][169] where every conversation is actually confidential.

[Start a chat][170][Explore Lumo
][171]

## Protect your business with easy-to-use encrypted solutions.

[Proton]

### Proton for Business

Proton secures more than 100,000 businesses including some of the world’s largest public and private
organizations.

[Get Proton for Business][172][Explore
][173]

## With Proton, your data belongs to you, not tech companies, governments, or hackers.

[Get your encrypted email][174]

### Fundamentally different

Proton was started in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN and shared a vision of an internet that
defends freedom and puts people first.

Our transparency, open-source software, and rigorous encryption have earned Proton millions of users
— and the recommendation of the United Nations.

Tech companies like Google or Apple define privacy as “nobody can exploit your data, except for us.”
We believe nobody should exploit your data, period.

Our technology and business are based upon this fundamentally stronger definition of privacy, backed
also by Swiss privacy laws.

### Privacy for a better world

At Proton, we believe that a better world begins with privacy, and this is at the heart of
everything we do. Privacy isn’t just something we talk about; it’s a core belief and the reason
Proton was created in the first place.

We also believe in people before profits, and our primary shareholder is the nonprofit [Proton
Foundation][175], whose mission is to fight for an open internet that promotes freedom of speech and
freedom of information.

[Learn about our impact][176]
[Proton Mail]

## Over 100 million people and businesses have signed up for Proton

[Join Proton][177][Proton for Business][178]

### End-to-end encryption

Our end-to-end encryption and zero-access encryption mean that no one (not even Proton) has the
technical means to access your data without your permission.

We don’t sell ads and can’t share your data. At Proton, privacy isn’t a promise, it’s mathematically
ensured.

[Discover Proton’s encryption
][179]

### Swiss privacy

Proton is based in Switzerland, and your data does not go to the cloud. Instead, it stays under the
protection of some of the world’s strongest privacy laws.

We are a neutral and safe haven for your personal data, committed to defending your freedom.

[About Swiss privacy
][180]

### Switching made easy

Proton’s services are so simple and intuitive that anyone can use them. Move your emails, contacts,
and calendars from Google, Outlook, and other providers to Proton in just a few clicks.

Connect your Gmail to Proton Mail to read, send and receive your emails in one place, bringing you
one step closer to leaving behind Big Tech for good.

[Connect your Gmail account
][181]

### Open source and audited

Since we were founded by scientists, we know that trust is earned through transparency and peer
review.

All our apps are open source and independently audited by security experts so that anyone can
inspect them, use them, and trust them.

[Proton and open source
][182]

### One account, any device

Access your email, files, calendars, passwords, and VPN anywhere.

Get Proton apps on all your devices (Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows, macOS, Linux, and more) with
one Proton Account for all our privacy-by-default services.

[See all Proton services
][183]

### Free forever

Privacy is a human right, so our services are always available for free, and our encryption tech is
free as well.

Proton has no ads and does not sell your data. You can support the service by upgrading to a paid
account with more features.

[Get a free Proton account
][184]

## Our story begins at CERN, where the web was born

View details

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists who met at the European Organization for Nuclear Research
(CERN) and shared a vision for a more secure and private internet. We believe in technical
excellence, integrity, and transparency.

Proton is led by scientists, including Sir Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of the World Wide Web, and
we work for the public good.

[Read our story
][185]

## Built by the community, for the community

View details

Proton is a community-first organization, created through a public crowdfunding campaign and built
with community input. Our only source of revenue is subscriptions from users.

We exist only to serve you, not advertisers or other third parties. By choosing Proton, you join a
movement of millions of volunteers, contributors, and users creating an internet that puts people
first.

[Join our community
][186]

## Choose an internet where your privacy comes first

One account for all Proton services.

[Create a free account][187]

> transparent and offering bug bounties, they stay ahead of security threats.

## With Proton, your data belongs to you, not tech companies, governments, or hackers.

[Get your encrypted email][174]

### Fundamentally different

Proton was started in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN and shared a vision of an internet that
defends freedom and puts people first.

Our transparency, open-source software, and rigorous encryption have earned Proton millions of users
— and the recommendation of the United Nations.

Tech companies like Google or Apple define privacy as “nobody can exploit your data, except for us.”
We believe nobody should exploit your data, period.

Our technology and business are based upon this fundamentally stronger definition of privacy, backed
also by Swiss privacy laws.

### Privacy for a better world

At Proton, we believe that a better world begins with privacy, and this is at the heart of
everything we do. Privacy isn’t just something we talk about; it’s a core belief and the reason
Proton was created in the first place.

We also believe in people before profits, and our primary shareholder is the nonprofit [Proton
Foundation][175], whose mission is to fight for an open internet that promotes freedom of speech and
freedom of information.

[Learn about our impact][176]

[Join Proton][177][Proton for Business][178]

Our end-to-end encryption and zero-access encryption mean that no one (not even Proton) has the
technical means to access your data without your permission.

We don’t sell ads and can’t share your data. At Proton, privacy isn’t a promise, it’s mathematically
ensured.

[Discover Proton’s encryption
][179]

### Swiss privacy

Proton is based in Switzerland, and your data does not go to the cloud. Instead, it stays under the
protection of some of the world’s strongest privacy laws.

We are a neutral and safe haven for your personal data, committed to defending your freedom.

[About Swiss privacy
][180]

### Switching made easy

Proton’s services are so simple and intuitive that anyone can use them. Move your emails, contacts,
and calendars from Google, Outlook, and other providers to Proton in just a few clicks.

Connect your Gmail to Proton Mail to read, send and receive your emails in one place, bringing you
one step closer to leaving behind Big Tech for good.

[Connect your Gmail account
][181]

### Open source and audited

Since we were founded by scientists, we know that trust is earned through transparency and peer
review.

All our apps are open source and independently audited by security experts so that anyone can
inspect them, use them, and trust them.

[Proton and open source
][182]

### One account, any device

Access your email, files, calendars, passwords, and VPN anywhere.

Get Proton apps on all your devices (Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows, macOS, Linux, and more) with
one Proton Account for all our privacy-by-default services.

[See all Proton services
][183]

### Free forever

Privacy is a human right, so our services are always available for free, and our encryption tech is
free as well.

Proton has no ads and does not sell your data. You can support the service by upgrading to a paid
account with more features.

[Get a free Proton account
][184]

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists who met at the European Organization for Nuclear Research
(CERN) and shared a vision for a more secure and private internet. We believe in technical
excellence, integrity, and transparency.

Proton is led by scientists, including Sir Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of the World Wide Web, and
we work for the public good.

[Read our story
][185]

## Built by the community, for the community

View details

Proton is a community-first organization, created through a public crowdfunding campaign and built
with community input. Our only source of revenue is subscriptions from users.

We exist only to serve you, not advertisers or other third parties. By choosing Proton, you join a
movement of millions of volunteers, contributors, and users creating an internet that puts people
first.

[Join our community
][186]

From the edge to your data center – transform your data estate. Deliver data sovereignty with
TrueNAS Enterprise storage solutions.

Get A Quote Get In Touch
[TrueNAS dashboard view]

## What is TrueNAS?

TrueNAS is a high performance data platform for managing any type of data, delivered through turnkey
self-healing storage appliances and expert around-the-clock support.
* [Performance ][69]
* [Security ][70]
* [Resilience ][71]
* [Scalability ][72]
* [Simplicity ][73]

### Accelerate Workflows,
### Accelerate Outcomes

Keep your teams productive without bottlenecks.

Low latency and high throughput keep your workloads on schedule, from powering VFX pipelines to
training AI model.

[Learn More][74]
[High performance servers]
[Security data protection]

### Transparent by Design,
### Trusted in Practice

TrueNAS is built differently. Our open core model ensures that critical code is visible, vetted, and
continuously tested by both our engineering team and the largest storage community.

This high degree of transparency leads to stronger, more secure outcomes. That's why the most
security-conscious organizations on the planet rely on TrueNAS.

[Learn More][75]

### Turnkey Data Integrity,
### Engineered to Self-Heal

Go beyond uptime guarantees. With integrated data checksums, automatic corruption detection, and
self-healing capabilities powered by OpenZFS, TrueNAS silently protects your data from bit rot,
silent errors, and hardware failures.

Even when things go wrong, your data stays right.

[Learn More][76]
[Resilience data protection]
[Scalability smart growth]

### Not Just Big

TrueNAS delivers the capacity you need without the overhead you don't. With high-density
configurations and power-efficient architecture, it's designed to help you scale intelligently, with
less rack space and lower power consumption.

From 20TB to 40PB and beyond, TrueNAS gives you the freedom to grow without overprovisioning or
overpaying. It's enterprise storage that's built to scale smarter.
